scope: All 34 V9 communication scenes; family-ear and audience editorial review
basis: baseline/reader-v9.md (character bios and locked story context)
limits: Editorial assessment of likely reader comprehension and voice; no claim of professional psychological assessment or testing with children. Candidate review pending.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Mimi wants an organized entrance; her children spot the missing phone.
findings.current_v9_defect: Shared folder and exceptionally secure filing sound like office banter before we know the family. Three lines each contain more than one joke.
findings.strong_keeper: Lost-phone captain; Dilo claiming the fastest solve; Luli bringing a book.
findings.fix_direction: Make the missing phone immediately visible and let the children answer it in their own short styles. Dilo can tease Mom without a lesson.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo wants the whole wall for theories; the others try to fit in.
findings.current_v9_defect: Shelf, appointment, cushion, waiting fact and evidence-space lesson compete. Nini and Alio also sound like adult satirists; Mimi gives a moral after the invitation.
findings.strong_keeper: Theories hogging a real wall; Nini wanting a cushion; family negotiating limited space.
findings.fix_direction: Keep one physical escalation that each person can picture. Let someone play along; end on a family consequence, not a reminder of evidence rules already printed above.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio wants his grand tunnel/minivan explanation to count.
findings.current_v9_defect: No courier is already explicit in the intro. Nini repeats follow-the-facts instruction; Dilo explains the parking joke for three sentences. Alio alone supplies foolishness.
findings.strong_keeper: Tunnel/minivan; Luli’s pointed zero-evidence jab; Dilo’s blocked notes.
findings.fix_direction: Use an absurdly overlarge theory in the margin, then a quick comeback. The intro supplies the investigation, so the banter need not teach it again.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio suspects the Cup’s manner; the real worry is a blank return record.
findings.current_v9_defect: Luli explains lawful sign-out and polishing before the paperwork turn; Mimi’s Better sounds like grading a child. Promotion adds a corporate metaphor.
findings.strong_keeper: Suspiciously good posture / its paperwork; Nini keeping watch over the well-behaved Cup.
findings.fix_direction: Let Alio make the useful paperwork observation himself. Short straight reply, pivot, family tag; retain the Cup’s dignity without four explanations.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Nini promotes a sparkle; Dilo worries it will replace him.
findings.current_v9_defect: Reflection, recovery from not being in charge, practiced shelf-standing and whole-room instruction elongate one simple appointment joke.
findings.strong_keeper: Inspector Glitter; Mostly sparkling; Dilo competing with a sparkle; shedding glitter reply.
findings.fix_direction: Let Nini enjoy her named object and allow Luli’s answer to be a joke rather than a disciplinary correction. Keep the photo task clear from its context.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo and Alio want the box to behave like an evasive witness.
findings.current_v9_defect: Two people separately explain that boxes cannot answer. Mimi’s seal update and Nini’s someone-we-can-ask make the adults/youngest correctors.
findings.strong_keeper: Suspicion with paperwork; professional staring; Mimi promising the helmet if it blinks.
findings.fix_direction: Trust children to know a box cannot talk. One practical bridge to Pixel is enough; keep the staring contest and adult participation.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo is staking his reputation on the locker contest.
findings.current_v9_defect: The door question is said twice, and every line adds a second comic explanation. Conflict of interest is harder at the young end, though the refusal itself is clear.
findings.strong_keeper: It has been briefed; badge question; Dilo treating a door as a rival.
findings.fix_direction: Keep the competitive game with concise replies. Let the badge refusal have an immediate concrete stake if needed; do not define the phrase or add a moral.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo wants an easy printer answer; Nini wants names she can use.
findings.current_v9_defect: Dear Dilo restates straightforward; Luli explains his whole personality; Nini’s list ends by explaining why it is unhelpful. Four voices share the same explanatory cadence.
findings.strong_keeper: Luli knowing he would complain either way; Nini tired of the thing; Bibi checking printer’s references.
findings.fix_direction: Treat it as tired family chatter around a strange printer. Use the marks and incomplete route as mystery tension, then leave the references joke unglossed.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Nini wants the promised dragon; Luli shares her disappointment.
findings.current_v9_defect: Emotionally prepared, qualifications and history-book chapter layer adult abstractions onto a wonderfully obvious spoon disappointment. The final line explains keeping fantasy out of evidence.
findings.strong_keeper: Perhaps the dragon was a cook; soup; Bibi putting history on shelves; pencil dragon in margin.
findings.fix_direction: Let the imaginary dragon grow through play, with Luli joining it. One necessary label question suffices; Bibi can object affectionately without dismissing Nini’s drawing.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio wants his dramatic cupboard search to have been useful; Mimi is tired of cupboards.
findings.current_v9_defect: Opening slowly is explained twice, Nini describes where all coats would go, and the closing task reminder interrupts the broom joke.
findings.strong_keeper: Only dramatic cupboards; eliminating tiny cupboards; Mimi talking to brooms.
findings.fix_direction: Maintain a clear moon-costume size joke, give Alio a defensible practical result, and let Mimi be tired and funny herself.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio wants a beautifully straight shortcut; buildings refuse it.
findings.current_v9_defect: Appointment metaphor drags; Mimi’s use-doors line treats Alio like a fool who has never entered a building. Load-bearing is a possible unfamiliar term.
findings.strong_keeper: Have you shown it to the walls; building rejecting draft; Dilo holding map rather than roof.
findings.fix_direction: Make obstacle/map mismatch concrete. Alio’s reply should show he understands his mistake and can answer back; one physical roof/wall punch is enough.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Bibi recognizes something but wants it checked; Alio wants promised cake.
findings.current_v9_defect: Bibi explains memory discipline already stated in the intro; cake receives an extra announcement and bakery investigation after reliable source/terrible delivery has landed.
findings.strong_keeper: Bibi’s limited memory; self-promised cake; reliable source, terrible delivery; children helping Bibi check.
findings.fix_direction: Keep Bibi allowed to be uncertain without a speech. Cake should reveal Alio’s appetite and self-importance, then stop at its best turn.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo likes the rover and its cable but needs the access record.
findings.current_v9_defect: Nobody move/I can complicate this labels him incompetent. Luli grades him twice; Dilo requests credit for being sensible. A robot expert becomes a child supervised by a teacher.
findings.strong_keeper: Two owners/one rover; cable as possible third owner; Luli volunteering to untangle it.
findings.fix_direction: Give Dilo ownership of a useful decision without a reward speech. Sibling mockery can target the cable or dismantling urge, with Dilo able to return it.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Children catch organized Mimi hiding phone beside breakfast; she defends herself.
findings.current_v9_defect: Undercover and source jokes are followed by explanations of compartments and the profession, weakening the fast call-and-response.
findings.strong_keeper: Whole source six-turn chain, especially Does the oat bar know / We protect our sources / You would not.
findings.fix_direction: This is model family teasing: children land the charge and Mom answers rather than preaching. Keep its bite; remove the explanations after the evasions.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo wants a serious parrot interview; parrot wants a cracker; Nini understands the negotiation.
findings.current_v9_defect: Try listening before your next question sounds superior. Statement consistency, lunch order, handler and Alio biscuits offer too many alternative endings.
findings.strong_keeper: Please speak clearly for the notebook; snack price; first interview with snack budget.
findings.fix_direction: Let Nini translate the bird’s priority rather than instruct Dilo how to listen. One strong snack-budget payoff; handler remains real, not a new invented clue.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio wants to rescue his fox-camera theory from its obvious equipment problem.
findings.current_v9_defect: V9 gives Luli two dismissals and Nini two more practical objections, then makes Alio retire with dignity: a pile-on. Source Nini joined his fantasy with a strap.
findings.strong_keeper: Pockets; tiny camera strap; Alio welcoming someone taking equipment seriously.
findings.fix_direction: Restore a playmate for Alio. His answer should sharpen the joke, not surrender to correction. The real photo can re-enter naturally without unfoxy evidence lecture.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Luli recalls feeding her bag books instead of feeding herself; the family remembers.
findings.current_v9_defect: Opening threatens to arrest a clock; lunch recollection then repeats who shared lunch, book contribution, recipes and a distant cake callback. Long scene wanders from memory mix-up.
findings.strong_keeper: Three books instead of lunch; Your bag was very well fed; books unable to share.
findings.fix_direction: Make Luli’s lapse vivid and let others tease her. She should have a dry comeback; no closing assignment to check her lunch.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Mimi wants useful labels; Alio wants impressive satellite gear.
findings.current_v9_defect: A theme tune, indoors/charging/arrival comparison and drawing a satellite all extend an already complete cardboard defeat.
findings.strong_keeper: Ruthless. You’ve beaten me with a piece of cardboard; adult practical win without humiliating child.
findings.fix_direction: Keep direct contest between ambitious equipment and readable tag. Alio’s graciously dramatic comeback is the laugh, not a request for adult permission.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio sees Bibi’s hat as architecture; Bibi proudly defends her younger self.
findings.current_v9_defect: Mimi flatly repeats the dating objective and says hat cannot date photo. Rent/extra-room thread adds length after roof-space already worked.
findings.strong_keeper: Excellent detective underneath it; admire respectfully / controlled limits; adult pride resisting family teasing.
findings.fix_direction: Let Grandma defend her taste with authority and wit. Date-evidence phrasing can stay brief if visually obvious; avoid turning the scene into everyone mocking her age.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio wants the same helmet recognized as specialist railway equipment.
findings.current_v9_defect: Professional development, promoted reader, travel points, snacks and separate seat all elaborate one accessory having a job. Bibi’s can’t-read barb risks targeting Alio by proxy.
findings.strong_keeper: Same helmet / changed departments; helmet buying its own ticket.
findings.fix_direction: Let Alio get his proud comeback. Bibi may join the absurd world rather than repeatedly assign helmet/owner homework. Travel-points reference can go if it needs explaining.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo’s watch is wrong and he dislikes admitting it.
findings.current_v9_defect: Correcting the record before anyone made him invites a good-behavior appraisal; Luli’s same-message-to-owner reassuring tag makes the watch joke sentimental.
findings.strong_keeper: Watch accepts error with dignity / And its owner / Less gracefully; Luli checks times alongside him.
findings.fix_direction: Maintain Dilo’s funny wounded pride and competence in fixing the record. Warmth is the shared checking action, not a speech that he has not lost his job.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo likes a digital ghost but wants to test the scanner; Nini would host it.
findings.current_v9_defect: Luli praises him for keeping fantasy out of evidence, repeating the character-growth lesson. Modern/no bedsheet and unfinished business reference can obscure the immediate library joke.
findings.strong_keeper: Ghost waiting outside; Nini offering book; Dilo refusing Wi-Fi password.
findings.fix_direction: Make the ghost a guest with library inconveniences. Dilo should make his scanner decision without being applauded for it; prefer concrete book/password humor to metaphysics.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Nini sees a worried pear in paint; Dilo questions it; Mimi needs panel.
findings.current_v9_defect: Mimi corrects their pretending twice and excludes it from the witness list. A six-line visual joke becomes a lecture about inanimate paint.
findings.strong_keeper: Very worried pear; Does it have an alibi / The pear is paint / Strong alibi.
findings.fix_direction: Let Mimi need the actual panel while accepting their game. Trust the child knows what a pear-shaped smear is; stop immediately on Strong alibi.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: The note has torn; Dilo wants to help without damaging it again; others need his care.
findings.current_v9_defect: Seven expanded speeches describe good process, fairness and memory limits. Everyone becomes a reflective mini-mentor during an intimate quiet moment.
findings.strong_keeper: No laughing at damage; Luli asking him to check joins with her; Bibi’s Maybe/archive answer; Dilo offering exact useful care.
findings.fix_direction: Protect the hush. Give Dilo a real job with a small practical invitation; no joke needed, no I-can-help-without-hurrying-paper self-explanation, no permanent sinner arc.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio imagines identical cases undercover; Luli spots their labels; Nini wants them home.
findings.current_v9_defect: Witness protection may be unfamiliar at eight; cover identities, marker-pen operation, new careers and teacher explanation keep amplifying one bureaucratic conceit.
findings.strong_keeper: Labels ruining disguise; Nini treating cases as tired after rehearsal; Dilo unwilling to read bedtime story.
findings.fix_direction: Use one instantly readable hiding-identity move. Let each reply change the situation; Nini’s play can redirect without please-don’t adult policing.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo feels personally challenged by an idle scoreboard and hates leaving it.
findings.current_v9_defect: Opening explains number envy before Mimi can puncture it; Luli embeds the whole witness task in her question; final score/witness add-on repeats rivalry.
findings.strong_keeper: It displayed a number / In a tone is an excellent recognizable sibling/family exchange.
findings.fix_direction: Protect the three-beat argument intact and quick. Let Dilo reluctantly leave a rival for the case; avoid motivational praise.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio has paused his tunnel theory to inspect actual mud; Luli pauses too.
findings.current_v9_defect: A long self-aware statement about trying this new thing converts observation into a lesson. Luli’s wanting to hear what you notice is scripted validation rather than sibling speech.
findings.strong_keeper: Voluntarily; what mud has to say; Mimi photographing rare quiet; Alio insisting Mom’s phone belongs in fair album.
findings.fix_direction: Keep reciprocal teasing and the fair-album comeback. The story already shows Alio lowering his pointing hand: do not narrate his moral improvement again.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Parcel has been over-helped; Dilo wants nobody to touch it; Alio wants biscuits.
findings.current_v9_defect: Mimi issues routing instructions twice; Alio explains biscuits are for people and he understands parcels, removing possible comic ambiguity.
findings.strong_keeper: No unauthorized helping; morale biscuits; parcel already helped too much.
findings.fix_direction: Let biscuit offer need no defense. Mom can include the reader through sharing food without a final instruction about advice/handoff.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Dilo likes his impressive solved-case stack; Mimi needs her elbow and table back.
findings.current_v9_defect: Both things can be true sounds therapeutic; Luli’s ruler supplies a new joke before Bibi can defend his harmless vanity. Last line extends paperweight to filing Mom.
findings.strong_keeper: Dilo keeping stack because impressive; Bibi Let him have both; Mimi’s elbow as paperweight.
findings.fix_direction: Let Dilo have earned pride plus a silly motive. Bibi is a fellow family member defending him, not validating a principle. End on a clear physical table problem.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Nini notices the absent people; Luli enjoys a witness who stays quiet; Mimi retaliates.
findings.current_v9_defect: Nobody not raising a hand and medal/contributed nothing prolong wordplay before Luli’s favorite witness. Bibi adds investigation instructions after a potentially sweet family tag.
findings.strong_keeper: Nobody as witness; Luli teased for dinner-long footnote; Bibi enjoying that footnote.
findings.fix_direction: Absence can be playful without making solution unclear. Keep adult and older sibling fallibility; a concise footnote counter-jab gives Luli fair return for brothers joke.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Bibi wants fragile plans safe; Alio wants to point; Dilo protests one-finger privilege.
findings.current_v9_defect: Bibi gives care rules in all three turns, calls excuses old, warns about prodding rooms and repeats hover/sleeve distinction. She becomes a gatekeeper rather than beloved archive expert.
findings.strong_keeper: No heroic folding; heroic point; solving parcel to earn permission for one finger; worthy investment.
findings.fix_direction: Give one crisp care rule then play the tiny heroic-point game. Bibi can win with pleasure. Do not imply children cannot touch anything or use recovered tools incorrectly.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Alio’s beautifully presented theory has no proof; Mom and Grandma admit their own versions.
findings.current_v9_defect: Heading/straight border/crest repeat the decoration; adult admissions grow into confessions and explicit approval of Luli’s question. Decorative confidence may be abstract without physical empty card.
findings.strong_keeper: Decorative confidence; Mimi and Bibi asking for cards; experience as Grandma’s own flimsy cover.
findings.fix_direction: Keep adult self-implication: this prevents lecture hierarchy. An empty evidence area makes joke concrete; stop on Bibi’s experience turn rather than explain the rule lesson.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Reader faces largest map; family makes room and waits together.
findings.current_v9_defect: V9 adds a long elbow anecdote and over-specifies staring at corners. Reassurance is at risk of accumulating into coached performance, though essential shared patience is intact.
findings.strong_keeper: I can be quiet for one map / written in pencil; team physically making space; We’re not going anywhere.
findings.fix_direction: Retain the quiet shared patience and one small sibling joke. No instruction after the reassurance; reader’s pace stays their own, without large victory or competence speeches.

findings.comic_want_or_stake: Reader gets final turn; Dilo and Nini are desperate to celebrate before door opens.
findings.current_v9_defect: Mimi repeats final-check instructions; Dilo explains noise escape; Luli’s rest-of-us-can’t-hear can sound irritated rather than precise; Nini explains why reader hears first; Bibi recaps journey.
findings.strong_keeper: Victory noise ownership; Luli’s concise timing limit; Nini secretly noisy too; family right behind reader.
findings.fix_direction: End with held breath, anticipation and this family waiting. A short warm invitation earns belonging better than recap or praise. Do not make the door open prematurely.
